A '''sentient species''' was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrahban]] in the [[Sarrahban system/Legends|Sarrahban system]]. Their home [[Star system/Legends|system]] remained neutral throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], although the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] eventually [[Invasion of Sarrahban|invaded]] the planet.<ref name="TRG1-115" />
